description: Only four counted days, so the chronic floor rejects the window before a ratio is ever considered. Retained to pin the null-not-zero distinction: with no established chronic window the ratio stays null rather than defaulting to 1.0.

disclaimers: Workload ratio, a monitoring signal only. Not an injury probability, risk score or diagnosis.
Stop and seek a qualified clinician for pain that persists, altered gait, chest pain, or any medical concern. Nothing here is a diagnosis.
recommend.limitation: Not enough recorded history to judge load.
